dependencies.basis: Japan's Flow of Funds Accounts were revised to implement 2008 SNA recommendations (pension treatment, investment funds, new transaction items, captive financial institutions) for consistency with the national accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The FFA will be revised once again in the first half of 2016 with the implementation of the new statistical standard (2008SNA). ... aligning the FFA with 2008SNA is desirable as a way to maintaining consistency with Japan's national accounts which will also be revised in accordance with 2008SNA recommendations

dependencies.basis: Relative poverty rate, Gini coefficient and income quintile ratio are estimated from the Survey of Household Finances and Living Conditions (equivalised disposable income).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Estimated from the 2024 equivalised disposable income, the Gini coefficient recorded 0.325... The relative poverty rate stood at 15.3% in 2024... Source : Ministry of Data and Statistics·Bank of Korea·Financial Supervisory Service, Survey of Household Finances and Living Conditions

dependencies.basis: The Current Survey of Production (and related industrial production indices) draws on the manufacturing frame and structural data established by the Census of Manufactures / Economic Census manufacturing component.
dependencies.evidence_quote: This survey is conducted to clearly identify the monthly trends in industrial production and obtain basic materials for mining and manufacturing policies. The scope of this survey covers establishments or enterprises that produce manufactured goods and mineral products

dependencies.basis: The Monthly Survey of Mining and Manufacturing uses the establishment frame maintained through the National Business Survey / Census of Establishments for sample design and coverage of mining, manufacturing, electricity, gas and water-supply industries.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Target population: the Mining, Manufacturing, Electricity & Gas and Water Supply industries based on the Korean Standard Industrial Classification... Survey unit: each establishment. Target population: around 7,300 establishments

dependencies.basis: Retail Price Survey (Trend Survey and Structure Survey) supplies the price data used in the compilation of the Consumer Price Index.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The weight is mainly calculated from the average monthly expenditure by item per household... (prices are collected through the Retail Price Survey framework underlying the CPI)

dependencies.basis: The Labour Force Survey sample is drawn from Population Census enumeration districts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: About 40 thousand households in about 2,900 enumeration districts, which are earlier selected from approximately one million Population Census Enumeration Districts, are surveyed.

dependencies.basis: The Economically Active Population Survey sample is selected based on the results of the Population and Housing Census and is refreshed periodically from the census frame.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The sample is selected based on the results of annual Population and household Census and is used for 3 years.
